# SPD-022 — import --file says an edited usage key has no column

## Brief
Since SPD-010 member notes carry duration_ms, tool_uses, tokens_out, tokens_in and tokens_cached. A hand edit of any of them is refused by accept_member_edit, which is right, but the reason reads "property 'tool_uses' has no column": duration_ms and tool_uses are columns the hooks write, and the token keys are derived from usage_json. The refusal should say these are recorded by the hooks and not editable by hand, the way spawned and finished already are. SPD-010's spec (section 8.2) left import --file unchanged, so this is outside the Team card build.

Evidence: bin/spud accept_member_edit: the fallthrough refuse(rel, "property %r has no column" % key); tests/test_team_card.py UsageKeysTest.test_import_file_refuses_an_edited_usage_key shows the refusal, on branch worktree-spd-010-team-card.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on sonnet, no children. **Tier override: sonnet instead of opus.** Reason: mechanical, one refusal message in accept_member_edit and the test that pins it. No Fable on any member, child or probe (Eric, 2026-09-13).
